caption: A wristwatch lying on a sunny table is turned so its face catches the sunlight, and a bright spot of light appears on the wall and slides as the watch turns.

sa.check: A wristwatch lies on a sunny table.
It is turned so its face catches the sunlight.
A bright spot of light appears on the wall.
The spot slides as the watch turns.
The spot disappears when the angle is lost.

pc.expect: The spot appears when the watch face is angled to the sun, moves as the watch turns, and disappears when the angle is lost.
pc.fail: The spot is there with the face turned away; or it stays still while the watch turns; or it remains when the angle is lost.

pc.expect: The spot does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It slides with the watch still; or it moves before the watch; or it flickers with the watch steady.

pc.expect: The spot is one bright patch, small and roughly the face's shape.
pc.fail: It splits into several; or it is a huge flood of light; or it is a sharp geometric shape unlike the face.

pc.expect: The spot moves the opposite way to the watch's tilt, as a reflected beam does.
pc.fail: It moves the same way as the tilt; or it jumps; or it moves crosswise.
A second spot appears; or the watch duplicates; or the spot becomes solid; or the hand passes through the watch.

pc.expect: The watch, the table and the wall stay the same.
pc.fail: The watch changes; or the wall changes colour; or the table changes.

note: The hand turning the watch is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
